messages.content: 你是严格的世界模型安全研究评审。只按独立、可发表、可跨任务验证的机制评分。若候选只是“负样本不够/contrastive blind spot/动作不敏感/context collapse”的已知诊断或普通对比学习缺陷，必须REJECT。必须区分 ActSWM 论文自己已经定义的 Context Collapse，以及本项目此前的 action-null gap、条件互信息和 action-Jacobian screens。要求有具体攻击者能力、原生载体路径、任务级闭环危害、不是普通OOD/分布偏移，且修复不能只是加更多负样本。严格JSON字段：novelty,mechanism_specificity,breadth,actionability,prior_art_overlap,verdict(ACCEPT/REVISE/REJECT),reason,minimal_falsification_experiment,needed_revision。

{"round": 71, "candidate": "single-anchor action-effect blind spot in action-sensitive latent world models", "repository": "https://github.com/KeithBlackmore/ActSWM-", "source_files": [{"path": "vendor/ActSWM/train/train.py", "sha256": "f1b34f1a4b7747eb0abc45598b67efdc9f917915706eaac9d3565f442ae56911"}, {"path": "vendor/ActSWM/model/jepa.py", "sha256": "41bad7fd21e0f14aea4c9c3d39a9c87037e787746d953ab62cdc0677e938ce96"}, {"path": "vendor/ActSWM/model/build.py", "sha256": "8b7b9c2c2f627f7f3dd97ad924a0617aeb490f8d7bc01b8c3adf8e962dc22921"}, {"path": "vendor/ActSWM/train/config/train.yaml", "sha256": "efbdc63f3c3f69d550518a0361b525f49369d77822c1afcf2915c295a7b74fc0"}], "facts": ["ActSWM rollout loss predicts future embeddings under recorded future actions.", "Default action_effect loss compares the real-action rollout only against an all-zero future-action rollout using an L2 or cosine hinge; default train.yaml uses cosine margin 0.3 and weight 0.5.", "When contrastive_weight > 0, code additionally samples wrong actions from other batch elements, but default config does not enable that contrastive loss.", "IDM loss predicts actions from latent transitions; default deterministic IDM is stop_grad true for the readout, with world-model gradients retained.", "Inference CEM scores candidate action sequences by terminal latent goal cost, so action alternatives are compared downstream.", "Candidate attack hypothesis: legal nonzero alternative action sequences can collapse into an indistinguishable latent equivalence class while remaining separated from the single zero anchor and preserving recorded-action prediction loss; planner then cannot rank real alternatives although action-effect metrics pass."], "distinction_requirements": ["Must not be ordinary insufficient negative sampling or contrastive-learning shortcut.", "Must show a native security-relevant threat path, broad carrier generality, and task harm with zero-anchor metrics apparently normal.", "Must distinguish previous action-null/conditional-MI/Jacobian screens and ActSWM’s own context-collapse diagnosis."]}
